scope: Protected three-page final reference and evaluation workflow; never training or checkpoint selection
unlock: Render final pages only after a selection seal binds the committed selection protocol, complete validation-only candidate report, selected base/adapter identity, this workflow hash and unchanged development evidence. The seal must state final_content_opened=false.
reference_policy: After unlock, visually review every 150-DPI page and a 300-DPI second pass. Use original pixels, never HF weak responses or PDF OCR as gold. Retain every semantic element and every difficult page; disclose rights/privacy scope. Commit complete references, scorer and their hashes before final model inference.
evaluation_policy: Run the frozen base and already selected artifact once on all three final pages in a separate process. Count every execution/parser/export/reference failure. Final outputs cannot revise selection; later tuning makes these pages development data and requires a new final source.
failure_policy: Incomplete review, unsupported content, missing artifacts or failed guards block a complete final-quality claim; never replace, omit, repair or quality-retry a page.
